$description: Clipmoor design tokens, W3C DTCG. Single source for code generation: base palette -> semantic roles (dark/light) -> component tokens. Palettes are override sets of the semantic roles; roles marked $extensions.clipmoor.customizable are user-editable, all others derive from them (see derive). Generated 2026-10-28 from the Clipmoor design system.

clear.$description: Dark selection-edge (no edge: the yellow ring alone passes 3:1 on dark).

stock-100.$description: Deeper stock: light strip and hover.

graphite-50.$description: Dark text, active edge, focus ring.

graphite-600.$description: Light muted text, light strip muted text.

graphite-800.$description: Dark strip/hover; light strip text (absorbs the old #2A2A2E).

graphite-950.$description: Graphite: dark ground and chip, light text and active block.

press-blue-lift.$description: Text type hue, dark theme: Press Blue lifted +0.06 OKLCH L to reach 3.26:1 on graphite-950 (was 2.52).

plate-violet-lift.$description: Code type hue, dark theme: Plate Violet lifted +0.03 OKLCH L to reach 3.29:1 on graphite-950 (was 2.88).

neutral-1.$description: Settings dark dialog surface, dark on-danger.

neutral-2.$description: Settings dark muted fill and divider.

neutral-6.$description: Settings dark field edge (new: 3.45:1 on neutral-0).

neutral-7.$description: Settings light muted text (new: was #737373, 4.35:1 on muted).

neutral-8.$description: Settings light field edge (new: 3.36:1 on white).

red-light.$description: Settings danger, light: softened brick red, OKLCH chroma 0.24 → 0.12 (was #E7000B). 5.62:1 on white.

red-dark.$description: Settings danger, dark: softened coral, OKLCH chroma 0.19 → 0.11 (was #FF6467). 7.03:1 on neutral-0.

ground.$description: Panel ground; also menus, dialogs, image preview, collapsed bar. Customizable.

card.$description: Item body (Chip, ListCard, CompactRow, ShelfCard). Equals ground in dark, where the card is drawn by `hairline`. Customizable.

strip.$description: Chip label strip AND every hover fill (old `hover` folded in). Derived.

active.$description: Active block: active tab, keep-open on, primary button, selected search text. Light inverts to graphite. Derived.

overlay.$description: Dialog backdrop in both windows: ground at 72%. Derived.

text.$description: Primary text on `ground`, `card`, `strip`. 14.6:1 dark, 15.8:1 light. Customizable.

text-muted.$description: Tabs, placeholder, hints, footer captions, second line of ListCard, times. On `ground`/`card` (8.43 dark, 6.78 light) and `strip` (7.00 / 6.10). Derived.

text-control.$description: Pills, keycaps, secondary buttons, on `ground`/`card`. Derived.

text-strip.$description: Chip label-strip text on `strip`. Light value absorbs the old #2A2A2E. Derived.

text-strip-muted.$description: Time and icons on the label strip, on `strip` (6.25 dark, 6.10 light). Derived.

text-on-active.$description: Text and icons on `active` (12.34 dark). Derived.

frame.$description: Window edge, control outlines (search, toggle, pill, keycap, notice, buttons, inputs), menu/dialog ring, scrollbar thumb. Old `frame` + `control` merged. 3.21:1 dark, 3.51:1 light on `ground`. Derived.

hairline.$description: Item edge and rules (filter divider, footer rule, section rules). Old `hairline` + `rule` merged. 3.21 dark; 3.24 on light `ground`, 3.53 on white `card`. Derived.

active-edge.$description: 1px edge of the active block and the active pill: always `text`.

swatch-edge.$description: 1px inner edge on colour bands, swatches and image thumbnails (decorative).

selection.$description: THE ring: 2px outline, 1px offset, on the selected item only. 11.90:1 on dark ground. Never anywhere else. Customizable.

selection-edge.$description: Selected item's 1px border. Graphite in light because yellow on stock is 1.32:1; clear in dark.

focus-ring.$description: The single focus ring of both windows: 2px solid, drawn INSIDE the control (offset -2px); on filled controls it takes the fill's text colour 4px in. Reads ≥12:1 on every surface it lands on (ground, strip, settings-bg, settings-surface, settings-muted).

type-text.$description: Text items: band and tab key only. Dark lifted to 3.26:1 on ground. Customizable.

type-image.$description: Image items: band and tab key only. 4.00 dark, 3.94 light. Customizable.

type-link.$description: Link items: band and tab key only. 4.26 dark, 3.70 light. Customizable.

type-code.$description: Code items: band and tab key only. Dark lifted to 3.29:1 on ground. Customizable.

type-locked.$description: Locked and untyped items: band and tab key only. 5.02 dark, 3.14 light. Customizable.

spectrum-red.$description: Colour-tab key: conic-gradient stops red, yellow, green, blue, red. Key only; a colour item's band is the copied colour itself.

settings-surface.$description: Settings dialog and menu surface (both now ringed by `frame`, no shadow).

settings-text-muted.$description: Hints, section captions, status on `settings-bg` (7.66 dark, 5.33 light) and `settings-muted` (5.86 / 4.89).

settings-muted.$description: Selected rail item, segmented track, hover fill, switch track when on, PaletteCard hover. Old `muted`, `accent`, `secondary` merged.

settings-border.$description: Row dividers only (decorative; rows are also set apart by spacing). Never the edge of a control.

settings-field.$description: Edge of inputs, ShortcutField, switch track when off, PaletteCard. ≥3:1: 3.45 dark, 3.36 light (was 1.26-1.59).

settings-segment-thumb-edge.$description: Selected thumb 1px edge (decorative; the 500 weight carries the state).

settings-danger.$description: Destructive buttons, refusal lines, conflict errors (always with an icon and words). Low-chroma by design so it does not glare. 7.03 dark, 5.62 light on settings-bg; settings-on-danger on it 6.37 dark, 5.38 light.

type-key-colour.$description: Conic (DTCG has no conic type): conic-gradient(red, yellow, green, blue, red). Colour tab key only.

palette.$description: Ready-made palettes: each is an override set of the customizable semantic roles, per mode. Derived roles follow `derive` unless a palette lists them. Grafit is the default and equals color.semantic.

gri.$description: Values not yet supplied: fill dark and light with the 9 customizable roles (and any derived role the code hard-codes).

haki-gri.$description: Values not yet supplied: fill dark and light with the 9 customizable roles (and any derived role the code hard-codes).

gece.$description: Values not yet supplied: fill dark and light with the 9 customizable roles (and any derived role the code hard-codes).

kum.$description: Values not yet supplied: fill dark and light with the 9 customizable roles (and any derived role the code hard-codes).

derive.$description: How derived roles are computed from the customizable roles when the user edits colours. CSS color-mix in srgb; then each role is clamped: if it misses its contrast floor against the listed ground(s), its share of `text` rises in 2% steps until it passes. Presets carry exact values and skip this.

dark.text-muted: color-mix(in srgb, text 74%, ground) | floor 4.5 on ground, card, strip
dark.text-control: color-mix(in srgb, text 88%, ground) | floor 4.5 on ground, card
dark.text-strip: color-mix(in srgb, text 91%, ground) | floor 4.5 on strip
dark.text-strip-muted: color-mix(in srgb, text 70%, ground) | floor 4.5 on strip
dark.frame: color-mix(in srgb, text 36%, ground) | floor 3 on ground, card
dark.selection-edge: transparent if selection >= 3:1 on ground, else text
dark.type-*: user value | floor 3 on ground and card: lifted in OKLCH L by 0.01 steps

light.text-muted: color-mix(in srgb, text 74%, ground) | floor 4.5 on ground, card, strip
light.text-control: color-mix(in srgb, text 85%, ground) | floor 4.5 on ground, card
light.text-strip: color-mix(in srgb, text 92%, strip) | floor 4.5 on strip
light.frame: color-mix(in srgb, text 50%, ground) | floor 3 on ground, card
light.hairline: color-mix(in srgb, text 48%, ground) | floor 3 on ground, card
light.selection-edge: text (yellow-like selections fail 3:1 on light grounds)
light.type-*: user value | floor 3 on ground and card: darkened in OKLCH L by 0.01 steps

mono.$description: The only mono declaration: index.css reads this token, no literal.

label.$description: Label strip, preview size caption, Shelf Ctrl-number hint. Always tabular-nums. Was 11 on an inherited 16.5.

keycap.$description: Keycap text in footers, Shelf hints, ShortcutField chips.

control.$description: Pills, notice, footer captions (footer was 12/18, now 12/16), ListCard second line, SectionHeader.

control-strong.$description: Active pill, SectionHeader, ShelfCard type name.

title.$description: Type tabs, menu items, DetailPane meta.

title-strong.$description: Active type tab, primary and secondary buttons.

body.$description: Item content, search text (was inherited 21px), dialog input, collapsed-bar text.

heading.$description: Empty-state title, dialog title in BOTH windows, panel header title (List).

query.$description: Palette layout search only (the one large field).

code.$description: Code item content, colour values, DetailPane code body. Never for keycaps (keycaps are sans).

settings-hint.$description: Row hints, status, errors under a field.

settings-body.$description: Row labels, rail items, inputs, segments, buttons.

settings-title.$description: Page title (h1). Line height is now a type token, not space s7.

space-2.$description: Segmented track inset and gap; label-to-hint gap in Settings.

space-3.$description: Pill padding-block; list ring room (margin -3 / padding 3 so the selection ring is never clipped). Off the 4px grid by design.

space-4.$description: Tab padding-block, gap between tabs, menu padding-block and item inline margin, empty title-to-hint.

space-5.$description: Keycap padding-inline, pill icon-to-name, keycap-to-caption, menu item padding-block. Off-grid by design.

space-6.$description: Chip content top, tab key-to-label, gap between pills, strip icon cluster, footer row gap, preview padding, ListCard padding-block.

space-8.$description: Gap between items, search-to-toggle, dialog actions, notice padding-block, Settings inline controls, CompactRow padding-block.

space-9.$description: Tab and pill padding-inline. Off-grid by design.

space-10.$description: Tabs-over-pills gap, thumbnail-to-value, footer padding-top, menu item padding-inline, field padding-inline, Settings stacked-row gap.

space-12.$description: Content inset (items, strip, notice), section gap, rule-below, panel bottom inset, dialog gap, Settings row padding-block, button padding-inline.

space-14.$description: Panel inset (sides and top), dialog padding (both windows), footer column gap, preview window margin, ghost margin. Off-grid by design.

space-16.$description: Palette pane padding, Settings rail padding, DetailPane padding.

space-24.$description: Settings label-block-to-control gap; empty-state bottom padding.

space-28.$description: Settings page padding-block and section gap; panel dialog side gap.

radius-key.$description: Keycaps, thumbnails, swatches, preview image, count badge.

radius-item.$description: Menu items, segments, rail items, color-editor swatches (both windows).

radius-control.$description: Search, toggle, tabs, pills, buttons, inputs, ShortcutField, notice, segmented track, empty ghost (both windows).

radius-card.$description: Items of every layout, menus (both windows; Settings menu was 8), image preview, DetailPane body, PaletteCard.

radius-window.$description: Panel window, Shelf, Palette, collapsed bar, dialogs (both windows; Settings dialog was 10).

control-sm.$description: Small control: pills (12/16 + 3+3 + 2), Settings reset button, source chips, count badge.

control-icon.$description: Ghost icon buttons beside the panel search: source filter, keep-open toggle, shortcut hints.

control-md.$description: Buttons in both windows (panel dialog button was 30), Settings inputs, ShortcutField, segmented track.

band-slim-w.$description: Type band of ListCard, CompactRow, ShelfCard, DetailPane list.

thumb-h.$description: Image thumbnail height; colour swatch side.

icon-sm.$description: Icons inside items, strips, keycaps and pills.

icon-md.$description: Icons in 38px controls, rail, collapsed bar (the eye included).

menu-min-w.$description: Menu min width, both windows (madeui 160 retired).

caret-blink.$description: Search caret: on 0-55%, off 56-100%, hard step.

preview-delay.$description: Pointer rest before the image preview opens (Ctrl+Space opens at once).

out.$description: The only curve: menus, dialogs, switch, segments, collapse.

motion.$description: Every animation runs only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. Under reduce: no caret blink (steady caret), popups appear without fade or scale, switch and segment jump.

component.$description: Component tokens reference semantic roles by name; resolve per mode (color.semantic.dark.* / .light.*).
